title: Step Count Weather Impact Condition Bucket Split
dataSources: Weather-station readings (`weatherstation:reading`), daily weather-impact rollups (`personalweather:daily`), sleep correlation records (`personalweather:sleep`), step correlation records (`personalweather:steps`), mood correlation records (`personalweather:mood`).
app: Local weather-station readings correlated with personal sleep, steps, mood, and outdoor-activity summaries in Splunk via scripted inputs and daily rollups.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=personalweather:steps
| stats avg(steps) as avg_metric count as days by condition_bucket
| eventstats sum(days) as total_days
| eval pct_days=round(100*days/total_days,1)
| sort - days
description: Shows how much data you have in each weather bucket and what average daily steps looked like there.
value: Knowing the sample size behind each weather bucket helps you trust or discount apparent patterns.
implementation: Review sparse buckets carefully before acting on them; a tiny sample is often just noise.
visualization: Table of condition buckets with day counts and average daily steps.
grandmaExplanation: It measures how much of your data happened in each kind of weather and what your daily steps looked like there.
